description:
DESIGN TALK (stored data).

Goal: a run records its configuration. Glossary (docs/00-glossary.md): configuration = trigger event, ref, threshold at the time, Claude Code version, model and effort.

Already stored: the threshold (copied into the run from the registration) and the Claude Code version (per source, from reports and telemetry; see Run.Sources in internal/core/model.go).

Missing: trigger event (the OIDC identity has EventName, internal/auth/oidc.go, but the run does not keep it), the run's ref (see ag-s99.3), model and effort.

Model and effort would come from Claude Code telemetry (internal/core/telemetry.go reads OTLP). Check which OTLP attributes carry them. They belong per agent run (source), since each Claude Code step can differ.

Rules: the server keeps only a fixed list of fields, never prompts or output (CLAUDE.md principles; docs/10-design.md "Trust"). Missing values stay missing. Ask Matt before adding fields.

comments.text: 2026-10-14: recommended answers posted to Matt in the project thread; awaiting his decision before code.

title: Record run configuration: trigger event, model, effort
